$comment: Failing fidelity cases, replayed on every run by both the text-only properties and P4 (phase-1.md 9.3). Every entry must pass. A case is a function of source, seed, type and, for a generated case, its plan attempt (which pins the plan and the draw whatever the edit API does) or, for a corpus case, its plan; FIDELITY_CASE=<source>:<seed>:<type>[:<plan>|:@<attempt>] replays it. Each entry stores a fingerprint, the intent the case draws, and the run fails loudly when the generator no longer draws it, so an entry cannot drift. `status` and `answer` record what the edit API must answer for a fixed bug. Seeds found on the old API were checked to fail P4 there.

cases.reason: Edit API bug, found by P4 and fixed (dep-anchors.ts): removeAttr start on a task that another task's `precedes` names leaves it without an anchor, so the engine deadlocks (not_scheduled, ok true to false). It is now refused conflicting-attribute. Pinned to its plan attempt, so it replays on the old API too (checked: fails P4 on 5b4dbfb2).

Pinned to its plan attempt (checked: fails P4 on 5b4dbfb2).
